learning_outcomes.text: Students, upon completing this course, can use their knowledge of basic grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation to understand technical texts.
(Reading) They can deeply understand basic and field-related technical texts by using text reading techniques.
(Writing) They can write short definitions and instructions related to a specific topic and summarize texts.
(Listening) They can have the ability to understand what they hear, recognize grammatical patterns in speech, distinguish technical texts, and fill in the blanks by following the book's instructions.

(Speaking) They can answer short questions about technical topics, create short dialogues, express their ideas about the discussion topics of the units, and use words appropriate to their level (such as expressing basic needs, asking questions about instructions or directions).
They can communicate at a minimum level with learned material.
They can follow technical developments in their field using different sources.
They can translate simple technical texts from English to Turkish.

syllabus_topics: Properties of materials, symbols, natural or man-made
Bit, byte, LAN and WAN, Midterm exam
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of our university's Senate.
